latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Free Video Generator Link

- Instantly generate shareable 1080p videos from product descriptions and up to three photos—no timeline editing required.
- Free, anonymous access with 100 credits valid for 7 days; simple setup with instant token generation.
- Cloud-based pipeline: uploads, text prompts, and exports all handled automatically with typical 1–2 minute turnaround.
- Supports a wide range of media formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- Robust error handling and session management, plus user-friendly feedback during processing and export.
- Common workflows include quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement with persistent timeline state.
